decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line changelog entry [ev-33c3af75761f], which says only that there is a "New logger for the Traefik logs" and points to PR #9515. It does not say what changed in the logging behavior, format or configuration, or whether the change is opt-in or affects every deployment. It also does not say what happens to an operator who does nothing. Deciding applicability and consequence needs the PR or migration/upgrade guide text that describes the logger's observable changes.
